title: How to Track Income, Expenses, and Net Worth in Nepal
metaDescription: A comprehensive guide to tracking your personal net worth in Nepal. Calculate assets, eliminate liabilities, and build long-term household wealth.
h1: How to Track Income, Expenses, and Net Worth
directAnswer: To track your personal net worth in Nepal, calculate the total current market value of everything you own (liquid bank deposits, gold/silver, Citizen Investment Trust balances, Employee Provident Fund, mutual funds, real estate) and subtract everything you owe (home mortgages, auto loans, credit card balances, personal borrowings). Net worth serves as the ultimate scorecard for financial progress.
author: Lalitpur Advisory Research Desk

sections.h2: Building a Personal Balance Sheet in Nepalese Context
sections.contentHtml:
Many individuals confuse having a high monthly income with being wealthy. Wealth is measured by what you keep and grow: Net Worth = Assets - Liabilities.

Personal Assets (What You Own)

  • Commercial Bank Savings & Fixed Deposits
  • Social Security Fund (SSF) & EPF Accumulated Balances
  • Citizen Investment Trust (CIT) Units
  • Gold & Silver Bullion at Current Market Rates
  • SEBON-Registered Equities & Mutual Funds
  • Fair Market Value of Real Estate & Residential Plots

Personal Liabilities (What You Owe)

  • Commercial Bank Home Loan Principal Outstanding
  • Auto Loans & Vehicle Financing Balance
  • Credit Card & Overdraft Balances
  • Loans against Fixed Deposits or Gold
  • Informal Family or Cooperative (Sahakari) Borrowings

Update your personal balance sheet once every 3 months on the final day of Ashoj, Poush, Chaitra, and Ashad. Tracking net worth over time highlights whether your monthly savings are truly translating into real wealth accumulation. Discover our comprehensive personal wealth review for expert guidance.

faqs.question: Should I include ancestral property in my personal net worth?
faqs.answer: Include ancestral real estate only if legal land ownership transfer (Dakhil Kharej) is formally registered under your name at the Land Revenue Office (Malpot Karyalaya).
